name: Hydrant
tagline: Issue tracking your agents can actually use, with reads first and writes with receipts.
description: Track issues, projects and dependencies with your agent in a workspace you control. Connect to Hydrant over Streamable HTTP and authorize access through OAuth. Start with read operations; writes return receipts. The linked repository contains public agent skills and connection documentation, not the hosted service source.

install.notes: Complete OAuth authorization with your Hydrant account. Verify read access before running an explicitly approved write.
